'''Torkel Laphmer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] senior executive of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. Before the [[Seizure of CZ-198]], he approached the [[Department of Adjudication]] to negotiate terms for information on the classified facility in exchange of a mansion and lifetime salary.<ref name="TOR" />
